description: List every environment configured for the currently connected project (e.g. general, staging, production). Testdata is stored PER ENVIRONMENT — each env has its own iteration rows. ALWAYS call this before tc_get_testdata / tc_generate_testdata, show the user the options, and ASK which env they want to generate testdata for. Never assume. The value to pass onward as `environmentType` is the `key` field on each returned env.
name: tc_list_environments
title: List environments configured for the connected project
